Where that happens, say so INLINE in the claim and name the independent falsifier used instead — do not let an unfetchable URL launder a claim into looking checked. SOURCE_DATE (2026-08-12): distinct from `checked`. `checked` is when I last LOOKED; `source_date` is when the source was PUBLISHED. Reproducible on demand and STRONGER than any article, even though it carries no URL. (2) DATED PRIMARY ARTIFACT — a fetched, dated piece; the standard for a factual claim about the world.
